meta_description:
poojadhingra on October 22, 2026: "18 years ago, I was a student in Paris with a cake and a dream. Last week, Le Cordon Bleu walked into my cafe in Mumbai.

Life really does come full circle. ❤️ Thank you, Le Cordon Bleu, and to the students who joined us. @lecordonbleuparis".
